title_zh: 苹果第四财季营收增长 12%，服务收入再创新高
content_zh:
苹果公布截至 9 月 26 日的 2026 财年第四季度业绩：营收 1144.77 亿美元，同比增长 12%；净利润 307.11 亿美元，稀释后每股收益 2.10 美元，同比增长 14%。这是 John Ternus 出任 CEO 后交出的首份季度成绩单。

各业务表现出现分化：

在随后的财报电话会上，John Ternus 表示，苹果今年 Mac 电脑销量创下历史新高。Ternus 表示，苹果目前正推进 AI 能力的商业化，部分基于服务器端的 AI 功能将设置使用上限，以推动有更高使用需求的用户订阅 iCloud+。

特努斯多次谈到新版 Siri，称其为「我们一直想要的 Siri」。

管理层预计，2026 年 12 月季度苹果总营收将同比增长 7% 至 10%，并创下公司历史最高季度营收；服务业务营收预计同比增长 8% 至 9%。
title_en: Apple Reports 12% Revenue Growth in Q4 as Services Reach New Heights
content_en:
Apple has announced its financial results for Q4 FY2026, reporting revenue of $114.48 billion—a 12% increase year-over-year. Net profit reached $30.71 billion with diluted earnings per share of $2.10, up 14% from the previous year. This marks the first quarterly report delivered under newly appointed CEO John Ternus.

During the earnings call, Ternus highlighted record Mac sales and outlined Apple's AI monetization strategy. To drive subscriptions to higher-tier services like iCloud+, Apple plans to place usage caps on certain server-side AI features. Ternus also praised the revamped Siri, referring to it as "the Siri we've always wanted."

Looking ahead, management projects December quarter revenue to grow 7% to 10% year-over-year, which would set an all-time quarterly record for the company.

title_zh: 曝下一代触屏 MacBook Pro 将换新模具
content_zh:
彭博社记者马克·古尔曼在 11 月 1 日的 Power On 通讯中透露，苹果计划明年推出第二代触屏 MacBook Pro，搭载 M7 Pro 和 M7 Max 芯片，并加入新的 AI 硬件能力。

苹果还在开发配备标准 M7 芯片的入门级 14 英寸 MacBook Pro，将采用高端版本上周引入的更轻薄机身和更窄边框。

目前，搭载 M5 Pro、M5 Max 的非触屏高端版本仍在销售。对于这条产品线是否继续更新，古尔曼判断，同时维护两套高端机型会增加工程、营销和制造负担，因此他预计未来阵容将逐步合并。
title_en: Next-Gen Touchscreen MacBook Pro to Feature Redesigned Chassis and M7 Chips
content_en:
Apple plans to launch a second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pro next year powered by M7 Pro and M7 Max chips, featuring new AI hardware capabilities, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman in his latest *Power On* newsletter.

Apple is also developing an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the standard M7 chip. This model will adopt the lighter, thinner body and slimmer bezels recently introduced to the high-end lineup.

With non-touchscreen M5 Pro and M5 Max models currently available, Gurman expects Apple to gradually consolidate the high-end lineup to eliminate the engineering, marketing, and manufacturing overhead of maintaining two separate flagship designs.

title_zh: 下一代 GPT 或将近期发布，OpenAI 用 1 万个 AI 智能体协作科研
content_zh:
据路透社报道，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 昨日在阿布扎比举行的 ADIPEC 2026 能源大会上透露，OpenAI 正在准备发布的下一代 GPT，可能正是此前用于研究纳维–斯托克斯方程的内部模型。

Altman 称，参与这项研究的是约 1 万个由该模型驱动的 AI 智能体，它们连续协作约 4 天，没有传统的层级结构或统一负责人。

OpenAI 今年 9 月公布的研究称，其模型构建了一套数学证明，尝试说明在施加平滑外力的条件下，一个最初静止且运动状态平滑的流体，可能在有限时间内形成奇点。

该研究围绕纳维–斯托克斯方程展开，这一问题属于克雷数学研究所提出的七大千禧年数学难题之一。

据报道，相关实验从 9 月 1 日启动，约 1 万个 AI 智能体在 88 小时内完成核心数学探索，期间交换约 270 万条消息，生成约 1300 亿 Token。随后，GPT-6 Astra 花费约 17 小时，通过 Lean 完成形式化和验证工作。
title_en: OpenAI Teases Next-Gen GPT After Swarm of 10,000 AI Agents Tackles Complex Math Problem
content_en:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced at the ADIPEC 2026 energy conference that the company is preparing to release its next-generation GPT model. The upcoming model is expected to be based on the internal system recently used to research the famous Navier-Stokes equations.

Altman revealed that the breakthrough involved a swarm of roughly 10,000 AI agents working autonomously without central leadership or hierarchy. Over an 88-hour period, these agents exchanged 2.7 million messages and generated 130 billion tokens to explore mathematical proofs related to one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems.

Following the exploration phase, OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model spent 17 hours formalizing and verifying the proofs using the Lean interactive theorem prover, demonstrating a novel benchmark for AI-driven scientific discovery.

title_zh: OpenAI 推出电网保护计划，拟让未来园区在用电紧张时降载
content_zh:
OpenAI 宣布推出 Grid Protectors Program，计划与电力公司、监管机构及政策制定者合作，让未来建设的算力园区在电网承压时减少用电。各地协议将分别确定降载规模、响应速度和持续时间。

在设备及当地电网条件允许时，公司还计划利用园区现场发电或储能向电网供电，并通过电池及电力控制系统平滑负荷变化。OpenAI 表示，园区应承担自身用电及配套基础设施成本，避免由家庭和小企业补贴。

佐治亚州 Effingham County 的拟建园区将成为试点。OpenAI 与 Georgia Power 的协议包含最高 1000 兆瓦的灵活需求响应安排，园区投运后可在电网需要时减少取电。公司计划以此为起点，将类似安排扩展至未来园区。
title_en: OpenAI Launches Grid Protectors Program to Ease Strain on Power Networks
content_en:
OpenAI has unveiled its "Grid Protectors Program," an initiative designed to collaborate with electric utilities, regulators, and policymakers to reduce power consumption at its compute campuses during peak grid stress.

Under the program, local agreements will specify the scale, response time, and duration of load reductions. Where infrastructure permits, OpenAI also plans to leverage on-site power generation and energy storage to feed power back into the grid and smooth out demand fluctuations. The company emphasized that its data centers will cover their own energy and infrastructure costs to prevent shifting expenses onto residential and small-business ratepayers.

The pilot project will debut in Effingham County, Georgia, through a partnership with Georgia Power. The agreement includes up to 1,000 megawatts of flexible demand response capacity, serving as a template for future OpenAI computing campuses.

title_zh: 机器人登泰山大赛收官，宇树 A2 全自主夺得竞速冠军
content_zh:
首届 CMG 世界机器人登泰山大赛 11 月 2 日在山东泰安举行，机器人沿红门至中天门的真实山道，挑战约 3.9 公里、3100 余级台阶和约 600 米高差。宇树科技公布，其参赛队伍共获得 1 金 2 银，本次只参加足式机器人竞速和负重两个项目。

北京灵翌队的 A2 机器狗以全程全自主模式夺得足式机器人竞速冠军，实际用时 41 分 41 秒，加上 2 分钟罚时后的最终成绩为 43 分 41 秒。上海高翌队同样使用 A2，以全程全自主模式获得竞速亚军，实际用时 47 分 07 秒，计入 7 分钟罚时后为 54 分 07 秒。

据宇树介绍，由于时间精力限制，宇树官方仅派出 A2、B2 两款四足机器人参赛。还有众多独立团队基于宇树产品二次开发后自发参赛，其中受到大量关注的「中暑」退赛 G1 机器人为开发者参赛。

赛事还设置人形机器人竞速、外骨骼机器人助力等项目。负重赛模拟泰山挑山工的运输场景，检验机器人在负载条件下行进、跨越台阶和完成物资转运的能力。
title_en: Unitree Quadruped Robot Wins Autonomous Speed Race at Mount Tai Competition
content_en:
The inaugural CMG World Robot Mount Tai Competition concluded in Shandong, China, where robots navigated a real mountain trail spanning approximately 3.9 kilometers, over 3,100 steps, and a 600-meter elevation gain.

Robotics maker Unitree Tech secured one gold and two silver medals across the legged race and weight-carrying categories. A Unitree A2 quadruped robot, operated by the Beijing Lingyi team in fully autonomous mode, took top honors in the speed race with a final time of 43 minutes and 41 seconds (including a 2-minute penalty).

The tournament featured multiple categories, including humanoid races, exoskeleton-assisted climbing, and load-carrying challenges designed to simulate traditional mountain porters. While Unitree officially fielded its A2 and B2 quadruped models, several independent developer teams also participated using customized Unitree hardware.

title_zh: iOS 限制后百度网盘仍可摇一摇跳广告，知情人士称新版待审核
content_zh:
iPhone 升级至 iOS 27.2，并将百度网盘加入「限制动作数据」名单后，开屏摇一摇广告仍可触发跳转。

有知情人士向澎湃新闻表示，并非百度网盘业务特意绕开这一功能，而是适配新版本尚未通过 App Store 审核，预计这两天可更新。

此前，有开发者逆向分析认为，广告框架可能在运动数据受限时改用其他传感器判断手机转动。

百度网盘机器人客服提供的关闭方式是，在 App「我的—设置」中关闭「允许展现开屏摇一摇广告」。

iOS 27.2 的系统限制则位于「设置—隐私与安全—运动与健身—限制动作数据」，用户可编辑名单，将希望限制的 App 加入其中。
title_en: Baidu Netdisk Shake Ads Bypass iOS Restrictions; Update Pending App Store Review
content_en:
Users upgrading to iOS 27.2 reported that Baidu Netdisk's splash screen "shake-to-open" advertisements continued to trigger redirect links, even after adding the app to Apple's "Limit Motion Data" restriction list.

According to sources familiar with the matter, the issue is not an intentional bypass by Baidu. Rather, an updated version of the app that properly adapts to the new iOS privacy settings is currently awaiting App Store approval and is expected to roll out shortly. Developers previously noted that some third-party ad frameworks might switch to secondary motion sensors when standard motion data access is restricted.

In the meantime, users can manually disable the feature by turning off "Allow splash screen shake ads" directly within the Baidu Netdisk app settings.

title_zh: 名越工作室解散，相关公告登上日本《官报》
content_zh:
据日本游戏媒体 GAME Watch 报道，11 月 2 日发行的日本《官报》刊登名越工作室解散信息：公司已根据 10 月 31 日股东大会决议解散。

名越稔洋此前参与打造《人中之龙》系列，离开世嘉后组建名越工作室。团队在 2025 年末公布了由马东锡出演的新作《GANG OF DRAGON》。GAME Watch 同时指出，工作室官网目前无法浏览，官方 X 账号自 2 月 17 日后未再更新。
title_en: Nagoshi Studio Dissolved, Official Gazette Confirms
content_en:
Nagoshi Studio, founded by *Like a Dragon* series creator Toshihiro Nagoshi following his departure from Sega, has officially been dissolved. According to Japanese media outlet *GAME Watch*, a public notice published in Japan's Official Gazette on November 2 confirmed that the company dissolved pursuant to a shareholder resolution passed on October 31.

Signs of trouble had surfaced prior to the notice. The studio's official website is currently inaccessible, and its official X (formerly Twitter) account has remained inactive since February 17. Nagoshi Studio had previously unveiled *GANG OF DRAGON*, an upcoming title starring action actor Don Lee (Ma Dong-seok).

title_zh: 阿里云为达喀尔青奥会搭建赛事云，赛后将移交为国家云
content_zh:
阿里云披露，2026 年达喀尔青年奥林匹克运动会已在塞内加尔开幕。这是首个在非洲举办的奥运赛事，阿里云为其建设奥运专有云底座，赛事结束后将整体移交塞内加尔，转为服务当地数字化转型的「国家云」。

这套平台在当地部署双可用区，承载票务、电子签证、运动员一站式服务等核心业务。票务系统覆盖注册、赛程查询、预订与现场核验，支撑百万张级别的票务规模；阿里云称已完成多次灾备演练，云转播则依托 OBS Cloud 向全球传送赛事画面。

现场还设置了「好客之鼓 AI 体验站」：观众敲击实体萨巴鼓并拍摄照片后，可由万相生成一段身着当地传统服饰、敲鼓欢庆的 10 至 15 秒短视频；千问问答助手负责介绍青奥会历史及赛事信息。
title_en: Alibaba Cloud Powers Dakar Youth Olympics, Infrastructure to Transition into Senegal's National Cloud
content_en:
Alibaba Cloud is constructing a dedicated Olympic cloud infrastructure for the 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games in Senegal—the first Olympic event hosted in Africa. Following the conclusion of the Games, the entire system will be handed over to Senegal to serve as a national cloud supporting the country's digital transformation.

Deployed across dual availability zones, the infrastructure powers core operations including ticketing, e-visas, and a consolidated athlete service platform. Designed to handle millions of tickets, the platform covers registration, schedule browsing, booking, and on-site verification. Alibaba Cloud confirmed it has conducted multiple disaster recovery drills, while OBS Cloud will deliver global broadcast feeds.

On-site interactive features include the "Drum of Hospitality AI Experience Station," where visitors beat traditional Sabar drums to generate personalized 10-to-15-second videos in local attire using the Wanxiang generative AI model. Additionally, the Qwen AI assistant is deployed to provide information on event schedules and Youth Olympic history.

title_zh: 香港金管局推出 SAGE 项目，探索 AI Agent 购物与支付
content_zh:
香港金融管理局 11 月 2 日宣布推出 SAGE 项目，支持代理式金融的应用探索，并同步建立管治框架。潜在场景包括面向消费者的代理购物和日常支付、企业采购与财资管理，以及机器之间按用量支付数字服务费用。

项目聚焦四个方向：验证应用场景、核实代理身份与授权、讨论互通标准，以及梳理法律和监管框架。其中，身份方向将研究「认识你的代理（KYA）」措施和认证机制；法律方向涉及管治安排、责任划分与消费者保障。

金管局同时成立代理式金融专家小组，成员来自金融机构、科技服务商、专业服务机构和学术界，为项目提供支持。
title_en: HKMA Launches Project SAGE to Explore AI Agent Shopping and Payments
content_en:
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced the launch of Project SAGE on November 2 to explore applications of agentic finance and establish a corresponding governance framework. Target scenarios encompass AI-driven consumer shopping and daily payments, corporate procurement and treasury management, and pay-per-use machine-to-machine transactions.

The project centers on four main focus areas: validating practical use cases, verifying agent identity and authorization, establishing interoperability standards, and structuring legal and regulatory frameworks. The identity domain will evaluate "Know Your Agent" (KYA) measures and authentication mechanisms, while legal efforts will address governance structures, liability division, and consumer safeguards.

To drive the project forward, the HKMA has established an expert panel on agentic finance comprising representatives from financial institutions, technology providers, professional service firms, and academic institutions.

title_zh: Anthropic 第三季度营收接近 170 亿美元，净亏损扩大
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，Anthropic 在 11 月 2 日提交美国证券交易委员会的文件中披露，截至 9 月 30 日的第三季度营收接近 170 亿美元，达到上年同期的约 12 倍。

这家 Claude 开发商同期净亏损为 233 亿美元，上年同期净亏损为 121 亿美元。财务更新发生在公司筹备首次公开募股期间。
title_en: Anthropic's Q3 Revenue Surges to Nearly $17 Billion as Net Loss Expands Ahead of IPO
content_en:
According to SEC filings reported by Bloomberg, AI developer Anthropic generated nearly $17 billion in Q3 revenue for the period ending September 30, representing a twelvefold increase compared to the same period last year.

Despite the significant top-line growth, the Claude developer saw its net loss widen to $23.3 billion, up from $12.1 billion a year prior. The financial update comes as the company actively prepares for an initial public offering (IPO).

title_zh: 💡 Omdia：AI 眼镜的差异化要靠可靠体验与服务整合
content_zh:
市场调研机构 Omdia 在最新分析中认为，随着个人 AI 智能体发展，AI 眼镜的竞争将从硬件进一步延伸到模型能力、跨设备和跨服务的整合，差异化的前提是提供手机难以实现的可靠、实用体验。

该机构以 Meta 计划将个人智能体 Muse 引入 AI 眼镜为例指出，免手持交互和第一视角视觉信息，有助于智能体理解用户意图与环境，减少用户解释需求的负担；任务随后可由设备或云端处理，也可协调其他服务执行。

在该机构看来，这种即时、自然的交互，可能让消费者愿意把更多日常任务交给智能体，包括过去不会交给手机语音助手的任务。

但可靠执行、清楚的安全边界与消费者对个人数据访问的信任，是智能体扩大应用的前提；Meta 过去的隐私争议会增加建立信任的难度。

Omdia 提出的竞争路径也不限于拥有自研模型的大公司：其他硬件厂商可与 OpenAI 等 AI 服务商合作，再用差异化硬件参与竞争。
title_en: Omdia: AI Glasses Differentiation Hinges on Reliable Experience and Service Integration
content_en:
A new analysis by market research firm Omdia suggests that competition in AI smart glasses is expanding beyond hardware into AI model capabilities and cross-device service integration. To succeed, these devices must deliver reliable, practical user experiences that smartphones cannot easily replicate.

Omdia highlights Meta's plans to integrate its personal AI agent, Muse, into smart glasses as a key example. The hands-free interaction combined with first-person visual input allows AI agents to better understand user context and execute complex tasks seamlessly.

However, widespread adoption depends heavily on execution reliability, clear privacy boundaries, and user trust regarding personal data. Omdia also notes that hardware makers without proprietary AI models can effectively compete by partnering with third-party service providers like OpenAI.

title_zh: 第二代海豹 07 将于 11 月 5 日上市，首搭云辇-M 系统
content_zh:
比亚迪第二代海豹 07 将于 11 月 5 日正式上市。新车已开启盲订，是比亚迪首款搭载云辇-M 智能磁流变车身控制系统的车型。

新车延续海洋美学 2.0 设计，长宽高为 5080/1960/1495mm，轴距 2960mm，提供六种车身颜色和三种内饰配色。座舱配备悬浮式中控屏、液晶仪表和三辐式方向盘，并提供 20 扬声器帝瓦雷音响；前排零重力座椅支持通风、加热和按摩。

动力提供插混、纯电两种选择。按易车披露配置，插混版搭载 1.5T 发动机和 160kW 驱动电机，配备 38.029kWh 电池，WLTC 纯电续航 245 公里；报道列出的纯电版电机峰值功率为 300kW。盲订权益包括优先排产提车和自由选配。
title_en: Second-Generation BYD Seal 07 Set to Launch November 5, Debut of DiSus-M System
content_en:
BYD will officially launch the second-generation Seal 07 sedan on November 5, with pre-orders now open. The updated model is the first BYD vehicle to feature the brand's DiSus-M intelligent magnetorheological body control system.

Designed under the Ocean Aesthetics 2.0 language, the sedan measures 5,080 mm in length with a 2,960 mm wheelbase. Inside, the cabin features a floating central infotainment screen, a 20-speaker Devialet audio system, and zero-gravity front seats with heating, ventilation, and massage functions.

The Seal 07 offers both plug-in hybrid (PHEV) and fully electric (BEV) powertrains. The PHEV version combines a 1.5T engine with a 160 kW motor and a 38.03 kWh battery, delivering a WLTC pure electric range of 245 km. The BEV model features a peak motor output of 300 kW.

title_zh: 问界发布 10 月出行报告：辅助驾驶里程占比 46.6%，活跃用户达 92.7 万
content_zh:
问界汽车发布 10 月出行报告：10 月 1 日至 31 日，搭载辅助驾驶功能车型的总行驶里程为 18.1 亿公里，辅助驾驶行驶里程占比为 46.6%。当月辅助驾驶活跃用户为 92.7 万，占用户总量的 91.5%。

报告显示，有 40.2 万用户的辅助驾驶里程占比超过一半；月度人均辅助驾驶里程为 910 公里，人均使用时长为 14.7 小时。

单车累计辅助驾驶里程前三名均来自问界 M7：2026 款问界 M7 为 18892 公里，辅助驾驶占比 98.5%；M7 Ultra 版为 17194 公里，占比 94.8%；M7 EV 2026 版为 15691 公里，占比 91.7%。
title_en: AITO October Mobility Report: Assisted Driving Accounts for 46.6% of Total Mileage
content_en:
AITO has released its October mobility report, highlighting significant user adoption of its autonomous driving features. Vehicles equipped with driver-assistance systems logged a combined 1.81 billion kilometers throughout the month, with smart driving accounting for 46.6% of the total distance.

Active users of driver assistance reached 927,000, representing 91.5% of AITO's total owner base. Over 402,000 users relied on automated driving for more than half of their monthly mileage. On average, owners logged 910 kilometers and spent 14.7 hours using driver-assist features during October.

The AITO M7 series dominated individual usage records. The top three vehicles with the highest cumulative assisted-driving mileage were all M7 variants, led by a 2026 M7 that logged 18,892 kilometers—with an impressive 98.5% driven autonomously.

title_zh: Kimi 发布游戏开发方案，可操作引擎并交付原生工程
content_zh:
月之暗面 Kimi 发布「游戏开发与创意工作解决方案」，基于 Kimi K3.1 Pro、Kimi Code、Kimi Work 和专业软件插件，将玩法验证、美术制作、工程开发及发行运营串联起来。

在立项阶段，团队可提供参考图、视频和玩法要求，由 Kimi 使用 Godot 搭建可试玩原型，再运行游戏、检查画面与录像，发现问题后修改复测。美术环节可通过 Blender 插件操作现有工程，检查多视角比例、穿插与材质，或按参考素材搭建场景。

正式开发方面，Kimi 与 Unity 中国的 Tuanjie Codely Agent、团结引擎协同：模型理解需求、生成代码并分析测试反馈，Agent 在引擎中搭场景、改工程和运行验证。Kimi 称，一次演示中系统无人工干预连续工作 20 小时，交付了可持续开发的原生工程。它也可在获得项目访问和命令执行权限后，协助 Unreal Engine 工程的玩法联调与场景搭建。

运营环节则覆盖投放素材、带来源的玩家反馈整理、本地化与 UGC 初筛。团队建议从边界明确、结果易检查的任务试点，并由对应岗位人员检查成果。
title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Game Development Solution Powered by Autonomous Engine Operations
content_en:
Moonshot AI has unveiled its new game development solution powered by Kimi. Integrating Kimi K3.1 Pro, Kimi Code, Kimi Work, and specialized software plugins, the system bridges every stage of game creation, including concept validation, asset creation, engine engineering, and publishing.

During early prototyping, developers can submit reference images and mechanics, allowing Kimi to build playable prototypes directly in Godot. The system autonomously tests gameplay, inspects recordings, and refines project files. For art creation, a Blender plugin allows Kimi to inspect model proportions, fix material errors, and build 3D environments.

For core engine development, Kimi integrates with Unity China's Tuanjie Engine and Agent framework to generate code, build scenes, and run validation. In one showcase, the AI operated continuously for 20 hours without human intervention, delivering a fully functional native project. It can also manage Unreal Engine workflows when granted permission.

title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 加入创作者模式，可用对话制作插件
content_zh:
DeepSeek Harness 推出「创作者模式」，让用户通过自然语言对话制作插件，扩展工具、技能和应用界面。团队在官方演示中展示了设计工作台、沙盒游戏和 3D 可视化等用法。

官方同时公开了七组演示提示词，涵盖地标 3D 展厅、Transformer 计算过程可视化、全应用像素风界面、海报设计、视频剪辑、论文阅读和会话统计。插件既可以在左侧栏或右侧栏提供入口，也可以从会话中打开。

其中，视频工作台的演示要求包括多视频导入、时间轴剪辑、预览与导出，以及在会话中用自然语言操作视频。官方提示，部分插件经过多轮对话调整，单次输入同一提示词未必能重现演示效果。
title_en: DeepSeek Harness Launches Creator Mode to Build Plugins via Conversational AI
content_en:
DeepSeek Harness has introduced "Creator Mode," allowing users to build custom plugins, expand developer tools, and design user interfaces using natural language conversations. Official showcases demonstrated applications ranging from design workbenches and sandbox games to 3D visualizations.

The update includes seven official sample prompts covering 3D landmark showrooms, Transformer computation visualizers, pixel-art interfaces, poster design, and video editing. Plugins can be integrated directly into the workspace sidebars or launched within active chat sessions.

Highlights include a video editing workbench capable of handling multi-video imports, timeline editing, previews, and natural-language commands. DeepSeek noted that complex plugins may require multi-turn prompt adjustments to replicate full demo results.

title_zh: 贾跃亭称 FFR 机器人 10 月销售及出货 351 台，累计达 1168 台
content_zh:
贾跃亭在最新一期周报中表示，FFR 机器人本体 10 月销售及出货量为 351 台，刷新单月纪录，累计销售及出货量达到 1168 台，首次突破千台。

他预计，11 月、12 月的月均销售及出货量将超过 400 台，并继续冲刺全年约 2000 台的目标。

周报同时宣布，FFR 与 FFAI 的纽约大区开始运作并启动招商，首期覆盖纽约、新泽西、马萨诸塞州、康涅狄格西南部和宾夕法尼亚东部，重点推进区域业务、投资者与资本市场沟通，以及政府和公共机构关系。贾跃亭还表示，两家公司已开启纽约大区人才招聘。
title_en: Jia Yueting Reports Record FFR Robot Shipments, Surpassing 1,000 Total Units
content_en:
In his latest weekly update, Jia Yueting announced that FFR robot sales and shipments reached a record 351 units in October. This milestone brings the cumulative total to 1,168 units, officially passing the 1,000-unit threshold.

Jia projected that monthly sales and shipments will average over 400 units across November and December as the company works to achieve its full-year target of approximately 2,000 units.

Additionally, FFR and FFAI have launched operations and recruitment in the Greater New York area. The initial regional push covers New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, southwestern Connecticut, and eastern Pennsylvania, focusing on business development, capital market relations, and public affairs.

title_zh: 腾讯发布 Hyra 2.0，让科研 Agent 从解题走向造工具
content_zh:
腾讯混元发布科研 Agent Hyra 2.0，将目标扩展到研发可反复使用的科学模型、算法与验证工具。团队希望一次研究留下的成果能用于后续任务，并让系统参与下一代 Hy 模型的训练基础设施、数据合成和推理优化。

为支持持续数天至数周的研究，Hyra 2.0 接入企业微信、计算平台和代码仓库，由 Overall 协调目标与资源、Mission 管理研究路线、Worker 执行实验。任务队列保存进展，独立复核者检查代码、日志和原始结果；较大算力开销及共享知识同步仍需人工审批。

腾讯公布的初步成果包括蛋白质逆折叠模型 HyInv、蛋白质语言模型 HyPLM-Flash、分子模拟模型 HyFF，以及量子纠错工具 HyQEC。团队称，Hyra 2.0 从头完成 HyInv 的训练与推理优化，相比 ProteinMPNN，生成速度提高 57 倍，生成序列与目标结构的吻合程度也更好。

机器人结构探索则产出五指「旋梯手」：在 DR5 仿真评测中，经相同预算的策略微调后，物体旋转速度比论文最优设计快 28.6%，尚未经过真机验证。相关成果将持续公开到 GitHub，供社区检验与复用。
title_en: Tencent Releases Hyra 2.0: AI Agent Evolves from Problem Solver to Tool Builder
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan has officially unveiled Hyra 2.0, an advanced scientific AI agent designed to develop reusable scientific models, algorithms, and validation tools. Shifting the focus from simple task execution to long-term utility, the platform allows research outputs to be integrated into subsequent projects and next-generation model infrastructure.

Built to handle multi-day research workflows, Hyra 2.0 integrates seamlessly with WeChat Work, computing clusters, and code repositories. The system relies on a structured architecture: an overall coordinator for goals and resources, mission managers for project roadmaps, and execution workers for experiments. Independent reviewers check code, logs, and raw results, while high-compute requests and global knowledge updates still require human authorization.

Tencent highlighted several early achievements driven by Hyra 2.0, including the inverse protein folding model HyInv, the protein language model HyPLM-Flash, the molecular simulation model HyFF, and the quantum error correction tool HyQEC. Hyra 2.0 completed the training and inference optimization for HyInv from scratch, delivering a 57x speedup over ProteinMPNN along with better structural accuracy.

In robotics, the agent also designed a five-fingered mechanical hand capable of rotating objects 28.6% faster in simulation than existing state-of-the-art designs. Tencent plans to open-source these tools on GitHub for community validation.

title_zh: 优必选发布 Thinker-Sim，打通场景重建、数据合成与机器人评测
content_zh:
优必选发布具身智能仿真平台 Thinker-Sim，以 Real2Sim2Real 为核心，覆盖真实场景数字化、规模化仿真数据合成和机器人能力评测。

平台采用自研 Thinker-GS 场景重建算法和 SimReady 资产自动生成技术，可将工厂产线、商业展厅重建为数字孪生环境，再加载机器人、生产设备和人员等资产，组合训练或测试场景。

数据环节支持多节点并行仿真；评测环节覆盖感知、导航、操作等任务，并可随机调整光照、纹理、材质等环境条件，测试算法的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

用户可通过标准任务模板和参数配置启动仿真，并实时查看画面、任务状态与结果。平台还提供可视化工作流，以及基于 Ulab-Agent 的自然语言入口，用于创建场景、配置环境和编排任务。
title_en: UBTECH Launches Thinker-Sim to Streamline Embodied AI Simulation
content_en:
UBTECH has announced Thinker-Sim, an embodied AI simulation platform powered by a Real2Sim2Real architecture. The platform unifies real-world scene digitization, large-scale synthetic data generation, and robot benchmark evaluation into a single ecosystem.

Driven by UBTECH's proprietary Thinker-GS scene reconstruction algorithm and SimReady automated asset creation tech, the system converts physical factories and commercial spaces into digital twins. Users can populate these virtual environments with machinery, personnel, and robots to build custom training and testing scenarios.

Thinker-Sim supports multi-node parallel simulation and evaluates performance across perception, navigation, and manipulation. Environment parameters—such as lighting, textures, and surface materials—can be randomized to test algorithm robustness and generalization.

Users can launch tasks using standard templates or natural-language prompts powered by the integrated Ulab-Agent. The platform also provides visual workflows and real-time monitoring of simulation video feeds and task analytics.

title_zh: 美团 LongCat-2.5 正式上线，支持视觉编程与长程工程任务
content_zh:
美团 LongCat API 平台更新日志显示，LongCat-2.5 于 11 月 2 日正式上线。此前，LongCat-2.5-Preview 已在 9 月 25 日开放。

官方将新版重点概括为原生多模态、长程 Agent 和跨工具接入：模型结合视觉理解与智能体编程，用于视觉编码、创意设计和 3D 任务；通过多步推理、工具调用和端到端执行，处理复杂代码库与完整项目构建。

开发者可将 LongCat-2.5 接入 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes 等 Agent 工具，在现有开发流程中使用。
title_en: Meituan Officially Launches LongCat-2.5 with Visual Coding and Long-Horizon Agent Capabilities
content_en:
Meituan has officially launched LongCat-2.5 on its API platform following a preview release in late September.

The upgraded model introduces native multimodal capabilities, long-horizon agent functionality, and cross-tool integration. By combining visual understanding with agentic programming, LongCat-2.5 supports complex tasks such as visual coding, creative design, and 3D modeling. It enables multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and end-to-end execution for full-project engineering across complex codebases.

Developers can easily integrate LongCat-2.5 into existing workflows via AI agent tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes.

title_zh: 曝三星 Galaxy Z Fold9 考虑恢复内屏屏下摄像头
content_zh:
据 SamMobile 报道，爆料者称三星已决定为 Galaxy Z Fold9 的折叠内屏重新配备屏下摄像头。三星最早在 2021 年的 Galaxy Z Fold3 引入这项设计，沿用至 Fold6，随后在 Fold7 改用挖孔前摄以改善成像质量。

同一爆料者称，新机升级重点将放在内部配置，外观改动较小，展开厚度约 3.9mm、折叠厚度约 7.9mm。
title_en: Samsung Rumored to Bring Back Under-Display Camera for Galaxy Z Fold9
content_en:
Samsung is reportedly planning to reintroduce an under-display camera (UDC) on the inner folding screen of the upcoming Galaxy Z Fold9, according to industry leaks.

Samsung originally debuted UDC technology on the Galaxy Z Fold3 in 2021 and retained it through the Fold6, before switching to a hole-punch camera on the Fold7 to improve image quality.

Reports indicate that the Galaxy Z Fold9 will primarily focus on internal hardware upgrades rather than major exterior redesigns, featuring an estimated thickness of roughly 3.9mm when unfolded and 7.9mm when folded.

title_zh: 国仪量子发布商品化核磁超低温探头与固体核磁波谱仪
content_zh:
国仪量子在 10 月 31 日于武汉举行的第二届分析科学与仪器大会上，发布 CryoHe 系列氦型核磁超低温探头和 CAN-S 系列高场固体核磁共振波谱仪，分别面向液体核磁的高灵敏度检测与固体材料结构表征。

据分析测试百科网介绍，CryoHe 采用闭循环低温冷却技术，使核心射频线圈工作于约 20K，以降低信号链路热噪声，灵敏度较常规室温探头提升约 3 倍。探头支持多种核素，以及自动调谐与匹配，可用于微量、低浓度及复杂混合样品的分析。

CAN-S 则基于分布式谱仪架构，面向新能源电池材料、多相催化和高分子材料等研究。此次发布将超低温探头和固体核磁整机两条产品线推进到商品化阶段。
title_en: CIQTEK Launches Commercial Cryogenic NMR Probes and Solid-State NMR Spectrometers
content_en:
At the 2nd Analytical Science and Instrumentation Conference in Wuhan, CIQTEK officially launched two major commercial product lines: the CryoHe series helium-cooled cryogenic NMR probes and the CAN-S series high-field solid-state NMR spectrometers.

The CryoHe series utilizes closed-cycle cooling technology to operate core RF coils at approximately 20K, significantly reducing thermal noise and boosting signal sensitivity nearly threefold compared to conventional room-temperature probes. Featuring automatic tuning and matching, it supports multi-nuclear detection and is ideal for analyzing trace, low-concentration, and complex mixture samples.

Meanwhile, the CAN-S series is designed for solid-material structure characterization using a distributed spectrometer architecture. It targets research fields such as new energy battery materials, heterogeneous catalysis, and polymers. The release marks a significant milestone as CIQTEK brings both high-end product lines to full commercialization.

title_zh: Affinity 免费一体化设计应用登陆 iPad
content_zh:
Canva 推出新版 Affinity for iPad，将绘画、矢量设计、照片编辑与页面排版整合进同一款应用。个人用户可免费使用四个工作室的核心工具，登录 Canva 账号即可开始创作；Canva AI Studio 中的 AI 功能需要付费方案。

iPad 版新增面向触控与 Apple Pencil 的 Sketch Studio，可用可编辑画笔起稿，再切换到 Vector Studio 逐节点修改矢量图形。Pixel 与 Layout 工作室分别处理照片和排版，同一个 .af 文件可在 iPad 与桌面端之间继续编辑。

应用支持 RAW 无损编辑、图层合成、多页文档和印刷输出，也能导入 PSD、AI、INDD、IDML、PDF、SVG 等文件。首发版本尚不包含桌面版的 Books、Batch、Data Merge、宏录制和天文摄影工作室等功能，运行要求为 iPadOS 18.0 或更新版本。
title_en: Canva Launches Free All-in-One Affinity App for iPad
content_en:
Canva has released *Affinity for iPad*, combining digital painting, vector illustration, photo editing, and page layout into a single application. Individual creators can access core tools across its four studios for free simply by signing in with a Canva account, while advanced features in Canva AI Studio remain tied to paid plans.

The iPad release introduces the touch- and Apple Pencil-optimized Sketch Studio, allowing artists to draft ideas and smoothly transition to Vector Studio for node-level tweaks. Photo editing and desktop publishing are handled in Pixel Studio and Layout Studio, respectively. Files saved in the unified `.af` format can be seamlessly edited across both iPad and desktop platforms.

The app supports RAW file editing, complex layer compositions, multi-page documents, print outputs, and formats like PSD, AI, INDD, PDF, and SVG. While the initial release excludes certain desktop features like macro recording and astrophotography studio, it offers robust creative tools for devices running iPadOS 18.0 or later.

title_zh: 星巴克太妃家族 11 月 3 日回归，新增高蛋白拿铁与伯爵奶茶
content_zh:
星巴克将于 11 月 3 日推出节日季「太妃家族」，共五款饮品：经典太妃榛果拿铁、不另加糖版太妃榛果拿铁、全新太妃榛果高蛋白拿铁、低因太妃榛果拿铁，以及太妃榛果伯爵奶茶。

高蛋白版默认不额外加糖、不含稀奶油顶，按标准配方，每大杯热饮含约 20g 蛋白质；低因版则面向不同咖啡因需求。门店低因咖啡豆已从 10 月底起升级为水处理法，经典浓缩、金烘浓缩和低因豆继续提供不同选择。

本季还将推出猪柳滑蛋软欧堡、太妃榛果芝士蛋糕和金沙软心星形挞。节日包装除四款新红杯外，还有周杰伦歌词主题红杯，全国将有逾 150 家节日主题门店，深圳深业上城店作为节日主题旗舰店呈现。
title_en: Starbucks Brings Back Holiday Toffee Nut Lineup with New High-Protein and Earl Grey Offerings
content_en:
Starbucks is officially bringing back its beloved holiday "Toffee Nut Family" on November 3, introducing a lineup of five seasonal beverages. Alongside the classic Toffee Nut Latte and its unsweetened variant, this year's menu features an all-new Toffee Nut High-Protein Latte, a decaf version, and a Toffee Nut Earl Grey Milk Tea.

The new High-Protein Latte comes standard without added sugar or whipped cream, packing roughly 20 grams of protein per hot Grande cup. Meanwhile, Starbucks has upgraded its decaf offerings across stores using a water-processing method introduced in late October.

The holiday menu is accompanied by seasonal food items, including a pork sausage and scrambled egg soft bread, a toffee nut cheesecake, and a salted egg yolk star tart. To celebrate the season, Starbucks is rolling out themed red cups—including a special edition featuring Jay Chou lyrics—and transforming over 150 stores across China into festive pop-ups, anchored by a flagship location in Shenzhen.

title_zh: 李佳琦直播间半小时卖出 2 万亿 Token
content_zh:
11 月 2 日晚，李佳琦直播间上架千问办公 Token。据第一财经报道，开卖半小时，直播间售出 10 万份千问办公个人会员月卡，累计对应约 2 万亿 Token。千问办公 CEO 陈宇森也来到直播间，介绍 AI 办公的日常使用场景。

今年双十一，Token 充值与订阅套餐已进入电商货架。据新华社采访报道，天猫自 9 月 3 日上线 Token 充值中心，接入 DeepSeek、阿里云、智谱、Kimi 等厂商，MiniMax 也开出品牌官方旗舰店。用户可购买按量付费充值券，或固定额度的包月、包年订阅。

受访视频创作者表示，复杂场景和动作分镜会增加 Token 消耗，固定套餐未必贴合工作节奏。针对不同模型消耗和计费规则难以比较的问题，国家信息中心大数据发展部副主任王建冬建议统一计量口径、建立换算标准，并规范计费披露、引入第三方核验。
title_en: Top Chinese Livestreamer Sells 2 Trillion AI Tokens in 30 Minutes
content_en:
During a November 2 livestream, top Chinese influencer Li Jiaqi sold 100,000 monthly individual subscription cards for Qwen Office in just 30 minutes, representing approximately two trillion AI computing tokens. Chen Yusen, CEO of Qwen Office, appeared alongside Li to demonstrate everyday productivity use cases powered by artificial intelligence.

The sales event highlights a broader trend during China’s Double 11 shopping festival, where AI token top-ups and subscription plans are becoming mainstream consumer commodities. E-commerce platforms like Tmall have established dedicated recharge centers featuring major AI providers—including DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi, and MiniMax—offering both pay-as-you-go vouchers and annual subscriptions.

As consumers adopt these services, industry experts emphasize the need for clearer consumer standards. Wang Jiandong, Deputy Director at the National Information Center's Big Data Development Department, recommended standardizing token consumption metrics, enforcing transparent billing rules, and introducing third-party auditing to help consumers evaluate competing AI offerings.

title_zh: 北京公布智能眼镜消费指南，购新补贴最高 500 元
content_zh:
北京市商务局公布《促进智能眼镜消费政策指南》，从购新补贴、首店首发、品牌联名、国际化消费场景、离境退税、数字化转型和国际市场开拓七个方向梳理现行支持政策。文件成文于 10 月 30 日。

消费者购买符合条件的智能眼镜，按扣除各环节优惠后的最终销售价格享受 15% 补贴，每件最高 500 元。在京开设符合条件的首店、旗舰店、创新概念店，举办新品首发首秀，以及开发 IP 周边、开设主题或联名店的企业，对应政策均设最高 100 万元奖励。

指南还支持重点涉外消费区域打造国际化消费体验空间，对符合条件的项目最高支持 2000 万元；数字化转型项目按不超过审定实际投资总额的 50% 支持，单家企业最高 100 万元。
title_en: Beijing Offers Subsidies and Rewards to Boost Smart Glasses Consumption
content_en:
The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Commerce has issued a comprehensive policy guide aimed at spurring consumer adoption of smart glasses. The policy document outlines support across seven key areas, including consumer purchase subsidies, premier store launches, IP collaborations, international consumption hubs, duty-free expansion, digital transformation, and global market growth.

Under the new incentive scheme, consumers purchasing eligible smart glasses will receive a 15% subsidy based on the final sales price after applicable discounts, capped at 500 yuan ($70) per item.

To promote retail innovation, the city is offering rewards of up to 1 million yuan for enterprises opening flagship or concept stores, hosting debut launch events, or developing co-branded IP concepts. Furthermore, eligible projects building international shopping spaces can secure up to 20 million yuan in financial support, while digital transformation initiatives can receive up to 1 million yuan to cover 50% of verified investments.

title_zh: 《影之刃零》72 小时销量突破 400 万套
content_zh:
《影之刃零》官方 11 月 2 日宣布，游戏发售后 72 小时全平台销量突破 400 万套。界面新闻按国区标准版 268 元的定价估算，对应销售收入已超过 10 亿元。

游戏热度也带动 A 股游戏板块上行。界面新闻统计，截至 11 月 2 日收盘，同花顺游戏指数上涨 8.91%，多只游戏股涨停。灵游坊同时表示，已记录玩家反馈并开始优化，将于近期优先修复一批明显 Bug。

这款由北京灵游坊开发的暗黑武侠动作冒险游戏，于 10 月 29 日在 Steam、Epic、WeGame 和 PS5 发售。玩家扮演仅余 66 天生命的剑客，在追杀中揭开武林阴谋。
title_en: 'Phantom Blade Zero' Sells 4 Million Units in 72 Hours, Rallies Gaming Stocks
content_en:
Dark Wuxia action-adventure game *Phantom Blade Zero* surpassed 4 million units in sales across all platforms within 72 hours of its release, developer S-GAME announced on November 2. Based on the standard edition price of 268 yuan in mainland China, total revenue has already topped 1 billion yuan ($140 million).

The blockbuster debut triggered a rally across Chinese stock markets. By the close of trading on November 2, the Flush Game Index surged 8.91%, with several listed gaming companies hitting their daily limit-up caps. S-GAME noted that it is actively gathering player feedback and preparing immediate patches to address technical bugs.

Developed by Beijing-based studio S-GAME, the title officially launched on October 29 across Steam, Epic Games Store, WeGame, and PlayStation 5. The game follows a doomed swordsman with only 66 days left to live as he fights off pursuers while uncovering dark martial arts conspiracies.

title_zh: 10 月电影票房降至 20.46 亿元，创近十年同期新低
content_zh:
据财新引用国家电影专资办数据报道，2026 年 10 月全国电影票房为 20.46 亿元，创近十年同期新低。报道将这一表现归因于国庆档票房偏低，以及假期后缺乏热门新片带动观影。

10 月 26 日至 11 月 1 日，全国周票房为 1.79 亿元，环比下滑 10%，连续第二周不足 2 亿元。《生化危机：爆发夜》《神探之痕迹》和《什么意思夫妇》三部国庆档影片，仍贡献了当周总票房的 60%。

前三季度，全国电影票房为 295.81 亿元，同比下滑 29%；观影人次为 7.51 亿，同比减少超过 2 亿。财新梳理 10 月 29 日披露的三季报发现，14 家有相关业务的公司中，仅两家营收同比增长、两家利润增长。
title_en: China’s October Box Office Drops to 10-Year Low Amid Sluggish Demand
content_en:
China's nationwide box office revenue dropped to 2.046 billion yuan in October, marking a decade-low for the period, according to official data cited by Caixin. Industry analysts attributed the downturn to underperforming National Day holiday releases and a scarcity of major theatrical follow-ups.

For the week of October 26 to November 1, weekly box office receipts fell 10% sequentially to 1.79 billion yuan, marking the second consecutive week under the 200-million-yuan mark. Holdover titles from the holiday season continued to dominate the market, generating 60% of weekly revenues.

The October slump underscores broader headwinds facing the domestic film industry. Across the first three quarters, total box office sales fell 29% year-on-year to 29.58 billion yuan, while attendance dropped by more than 200 million viewers. Among 14 listed film companies that disclosed third-quarter financial results, only two posted positive year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit.

title_zh: 《波西·杰克逊》第三季发布正式预告，11 月 20 日开播
content_zh:
《波西·杰克逊》第三季发布首支完整预告，将于 11 月 20 日在 Disney+ 开播。本季改编自 Rick Riordan 原著系列第三部《巨神之咒》，波西一行将踏上营救安娜贝丝的旅程，并面对诸神与泰坦之间逐渐逼近的战争。

Walker Scobell、Leah Sava Jeffries 等继续出演，Tamara Smart 饰演宙斯之女塔莉娅。预告首次展示 Nico 和 Bianca di Angelo 两名冥王子女，也带来青铜巨人 Talos 等新威胁。

新加入的神祇阵容包括 Kate McKinnon 饰演阿佛洛狄忒、温明娜饰演赫拉、Dafne Keen 饰演阿尔忒弥斯，以及 Jennifer Beals 饰演得墨忒耳。
title_en: 'Percy Jackson' Season 3 Trailer Drops Ahead of November 20 Premiere on Disney+
content_en:
Disney+ has unveiled the official trailer for the third season of *Percy Jackson*, which is scheduled to premiere on November 20. Adapted from Rick Riordan's third novel, *The Titan's Curse*, the upcoming installment follows Percy and his allies on a high-stakes mission to rescue Annabeth as an all-out war between the Gods and Titans looms.

Returning leads Walker Scobell and Leah Sava Jeffries are joined by Tamara Smart, who stars as Thalia, daughter of Zeus. The teaser provides a first look at Hades' children, Nico and Bianca di Angelo, while teasing formidable new mythic threats, including the bronze giant Talos.

The new season also boasts a stellar lineup of new deities: Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite, Ming-Na Wen as Hera, Dafne Keen as Artemis, and Jennifer Beals as Demeter.
